origin.title: Where are you from?
origin.subtitle: Origin helps the AI lean toward the food culture you identify with. Current residence helps it bias toward ingredients that are easier to find around you.
origin.countryOfOriginHint: Where you grew up or identify with culinarily
origin.countryOfResidenceHint: Where you currently live — affects available ingredients
origin.fallbackNote: Leave one or both empty if you want. The AI will fall back to your photo and meal text only.
origin.preferredLanguageHint: Choose your language for the app interface

bodyMetrics.title: Your body metrics
bodyMetrics.subtitle: We use these to calculate your daily calorie and macro targets.
bodyMetrics.sedentary: Sedentary (Office job, little to no exercise)

cooking.title: Your cooking habits
cooking.subtitle: Help the AI understand how you typically cook so it can give more accurate calorie estimates.
cooking.oilMinimalHint: Dry, clean taste. Dish looks matte.
cooking.oilNormalHint: Light coating. Slight sheen on food.
cooking.oilHint: How much oil/fat you typically use when cooking
cooking.riceHint: Your typical serving of rice per meal
cooking.sugarHint: How much sugar you use for caramelizing/braising
cooking.proteinSmallHint: Smaller than your palm, e.g. ~2-3 eggs
cooking.proteinLargeHint: Bigger than your palm, e.g. a chicken thigh or more
cooking.proteinHint: Typical amount of meat/fish per meal
cooking.brothLeaveHint: Eat the solids, skip most broth
cooking.brothFinishHint: Drink all or most of the broth
cooking.brothHint: How much broth you typically drink from soups/stews
